Operational Description

When ignition key H001 is turned as far as it will go (AVV) - pin 50 - a signal is sent to short-circuiting junction D097 B (pin 4). This distributes the signal to the electromagnet winding (pin 50) of starter motor A020.

This power supply leaves battery A001 via a line protected by fuse F03 of engine bay junction unit B001.

See E1010 SUPPLY

Pin 30 of starter motor A020 is also divided into 2 separate connectors: connector A receives a power supply directly from battery A001.

The direct current generated by alternator A010 is sent from pin B+ to battery A001, through connector B of starter motor A020. If the alternator will not turn and thus charge the battery, an earth signal is sent from pin D+ to Body Computer M001 (pin 19 connector A). This is then connected via the CAN network to instrument panel E050, which displays an alternator fault message on the instrument panel display.

The car is also equipped with a battery disconnection switch inside the maxifuse junction unit on battery B099.

If there is an accident, the vehicle cuts off the supply to the fuel pump through the inertia switch I050 ( < R1 > ) which, once open, ensures that an earth signal reaches the luggage compartment junction unit M063 (pin 33 connector F). The control unit then forwards this negative signal to pin 34 of connector F leading to the coil of the above battery disconnector. The contact is thus opened to prevent distribution of a +30 supply from the battery to all electric components in the car.

See E1010 SUPPLY
